name: query_precision_medicine_kg
description: Query the precision medicine knowledge graph (17,000 diseases, 4M relationships) for gene/disease/drug neighbors (requires data lake volume mounted)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.data_lake import query_precision_medicine_kg; result = query_precision_medicine_kg('BRCA1', entity_type='gene', relation='associated_with', top_k=20)

parameters.entity: str — entity name (gene, disease, or drug)
parameters.relation: str — optional relation type to filter by (e.g. 'associated_with', 'treats')
parameters.top_k: int — number of results to return (default 20)

returns: dict with keys: entity, entity_type, n_neighbors, neighbors (list of {target_name, target_type, relation, weight}), source
